name: manual_37ed59
claim: git add --renormalize with 'text eol=crlf' in .gitattributes can store raw CRLF bytes in the blob on macOS, creating a phantom git diff where cmp shows working-tree and HEAD blob are byte-identical yet git diff HEAD shows 69+ lines changed. Fix: write LF content to file, git add (normalizes to LF blob), commit locally, then git pull --rebase drops it as 'patch already upstream'.

decisions.notes: Blocked orama git pull for hours (platform/windows/gstack-brain-sync.cmd). git update-index --assume-unchanged masks but does not fix; correct fix is LF-content re-stage.
